$comment: The public Ambassador Program page (the front page, /; /join/ redirects there). The idea: think of someone who's figuring out what's next. The hero is the mockup's; the three covers are chapter titles and each chapter's opener flows from its cover. [N] marks a number still to be set. Every 'Become an ambassador' button goes to /apply/ (content/site/apply.json). The launch roster reads data/roster.json.
title: Ambassador Program
description: Think of someone who's figuring out what's next. Ten minutes to get in, the words to bring them, and a pin that can't be bought.

title: Ambassador
Program
hero.pinAlt: The ambassador pin, floating and turning to follow your pointer
hero.lede: A volunteer corps for people who can't keep a good thing to themselves.

mission.title: Spark curiosity.
mission.alt: Teal cat-eye enamel glowing into ink, with fine teal glitter

mission.title: Build community.
mission.alt: A raised nickel line tracing the swoosh over red enamel

mission.title: Inspire confidence.
mission.alt: Red cat-eye enamel with fine red glitter

you.title: It starts with you.
you.lede: Someone got you curious. Now think of who's next. It pays you back three ways.

items.label: As a neighbor
items.title: A say in what gets built.
items.body: What you hear becomes what The Labs takes on.

items.label: As a person
items.title: Confidence you earn.
items.body: Tell your story. Hold a room.

argument.title: You found your way through.
argument.body: You did the getting. The Labs made room. Now you know the way.

argument.title: Be the one who says “come with me.”
argument.body: No pitch. Just someone they trust, saying it.

argument.title: Be how it reaches the next neighborhood.
argument.body: The Labs isn't a place. A region picks it up. Only if someone says so.

argument.title: Be early to something built to last. Bring someone.
argument.body: A year old, volunteer-run, and hoping to outlast us all. Every person you bring is one more pair of hands.

labs.title: Worth being curious about.
labs.lede: Free. Volunteer-run. A year old, and born in a library.

habits.title: We decide together.
habits.body: Everyone gets a vote on the problems.

habits.title: We learn by building.
habits.body: Real things, for real problems, built to last.

ripple.title: One conversation. Then a network.
ripple.lede: Every person you bring in brings someone too.

rings.title: Your neighbors
rings.body: A pod, a real problem, something that lasts.

rings.title: Everywhere
rings.body: Every region, every neighborhood. The future of work gets built either way. This way, everyone has a hand in it.

ripple.note: America's first lending library began with a dozen neighbors teaching each other. The Labs began inside a library.
ripple.videoLabel: The Labs orb as a planet, teal glowing from its upper left and red from its lower right, at the centre of dense rings made of networks that orbit it. A pulse leaves the orb, travels node to node through each ring, and leaps across the gaps between rings in small arcs of light, like synapses firing.

team.title: Curiosity goes both ways.
team.lede: Every conversation is research. What you hear shapes what The Labs takes on.

roles.title: Take the mic.
roles.body: One talk to a room. You'll practice first.

roles.title: Say your name.
roles.body: They join and say you sent them. It counts.

title: The button says you're in.
The pin says you passed it on.

steps.title: Get in.
steps.body: Ten minutes on your phone. Your coordinator hands you the button.

steps.title: Get ready.
steps.body: Five short steps in the guide. Half an hour, whenever.

steps.title: Pass it on.
steps.body: [N] new Upskillers. One talk. One new ambassador. The pin is yours.

rewards.title: The button
rewards.body: Ten minutes in, it's in your hand. It's how ambassadors spot each other.
rewards.alt: The ambassador button: the orb mark on ink, ringed by THE UPSKILLING LABS and AMBASSADOR in white

rewards.title: The pin
rewards.body: It can't be bought, only passed on. One pin for everyone who keeps The Labs running.
rewards.alt: The pin: the orb mark in polished nickel with teal and red cat-eye enamel

goal.title: What we're building, together.
goal.note: Two new Upskillers a week per ambassador. Nobody carries it alone.

quote.$comment: Quoted from Technical.ly, 2025-09-12 (Kaela Roeder). Confirm with Suzie before launch.
quote.text: You don't need a computer science degree to thrive in tech. You just need to be curious, persistent, and you need a community to help you.
quote.name: Suzie Zhang

faq.title: Before you ask.

items.a: No. Not this, not The Labs.

items.q: How much time does it take?
items.a: Ten minutes to get in. Half an hour to get ready. Then conversations you'd have anyway, and one talk.

items.q: Do I have to sell anything?
items.a: No. Nothing's for sale. Tell your story and point people to theupskillinglabs.org.

items.q: Do I need to be technical?

items.a: Any time. The door stays open.
Your coordinator. They're in the guide.

items.title: A few conversations. One talk.
items.body: Plus half an hour with the guide first.

items.label: Who can join
items.title: Anyone who wants others to find The Labs.

items.label: What happens next
items.title: Ten minutes, then the button.
items.body: Raise your hand at an event. The guide takes it from there.
